name: Bibop Bunk Bed in Light Acacia
description: The modern Parisot Bibop Bunk Beds are a great space saving solution for your growing child. The Parisot Bibop Bunk Beds can be ordered either as normal bunk beds or can be ordered to include the cleverly designed storage or sleepover option. The Parisot Bibop Bunk Beds are available in a white or beech finish. The sleek design to these bunk beds feature a staircase to the top bunk makes for climbing into bed even safer. Along the staircase features clever storage shelves integrated into the staircase hence maximize on space. The Parisot Bibop Bunk Beds feature reversible back panels on shelving units finished in light brown on one side & light pink on other side. Available to order in a White finish or a Beech finish. Mattress: We have a selection of mattress options available for this unit. The Irish bed base standard size is 190cmx90cm, the bed bases are 200cm in length. Our 190cmx90cm & 200cmx90cm mattresses are both suitable for this base, however for our customers we recommend the 190cmx90cm mattress as the fit allows greater ease in fitting and changing bed sheets. Please note if purchasing the 90x190cm you will have a gap of 10cm at the end of the bed. Should you wish to purchase 90x200cm please contact us directly.
